title: Department of Homeland Security: Cybersecurity: Network Monitoring Program Recommendation Status, May 2026
summary: GAO's public status page retained four DHS and CISA Continuous Diagnostics and Mitigation recommendations as open in May 2026. Entity test: The later records challenge any closure assumption and block extension of the FY 2024 enterprise rating into FY 2025.
key_findings: The open items covered guidance, data-quality milestones, persistent-access onboarding, and cloud-asset strategy.
Alternative-explanation test: Tests controls outside CDM, component variation, endpoint coverage, data quality, and cloud-asset management.
Compatibility: Same department and CDM control input; the enterprise annual result and program recommendation statuses remain separate measurement systems.
why_it_matters: This record either supplies a later compatible observation or tests a named Phase 56C alternative explanation without turning association into causal proof.
ftfn_relevance: Preserves the Phase 56C parent dossier and stable entity identifier.
Maps the record to named alternative explanations.
Separates observed result, attribution, independent validation, and unresolved denominators.
evidence_limits: Recommendation status does not measure the DHS enterprise rating or identical implementation across components and systems.
Independent official status records; no missing annual outcome is imputed.
No causal effect, ranking, composite score, readiness score, or unsupported cross-entity comparison is supported.
